paite: Hiai thilte nung in, Persia kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai in, Seraiah tapa Ezra, Azariah tapa, Hilkiah tapa,
heading: Jerusalem Ah Ezra Ahong Tung

paite: Shallum tapa, Zadok tapa, Ahitub tapa,
Amariah tapa, Azariah tapa, Meraioth tapa,
Zerahiah tapa, Uzzi tapa, Bukki tapa,
Abishua tapa, Phinehas tapa, Eleazar tapa, Aaron siampu lian tapa:
Babulon a kipan in hiai Ezra apaitou a; amah Mosi Dan, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in apiak, dan theisa ahi a: atung a TOUPA a Pathian khut a-om dungzui in, angetna tengteng kumpipa'n aphalsak hi.
Huan kumpipa Artaksarses kum sagih kum in, Jerusalem ah Israel suante lak a akhen, siampute lak a akhen, Levi mite, lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, ahohtou ua.
Huchi in kumpipa akum sagih kum akha ngana in Jerusalem ah Ezra ahong pai hi.
Babulon a kipan akha khatna ani khat ni in akuantou pan a, akha ngana ani khat ni in a Pathian khut hoih atung a a-om bang zel in, Jerusalem ah ahong pai hi.
Ezra in bel TOUPA Dan zong ding, zui ding leh Israel tua dan thusehte leh vaihawmnate sinsak ding in alungtang akoihkip hi.
Tu in kumpipa Artaksarses in siampu, laigelhmi, TOUPA thupiakte thu gelhmi leh Israel kiang a adan thusehte gelhmi Ezra kiang a apiak laikhak teisawn hiai ahi.
heading: Ezra Kiang A Kumpipa Artaksarses Lai Piak

paite: Artaksarses, kumpipate' kumpipa'n, siampu, van Pathian Dan gelhmi, buching leh huchibang zel in, Ezra kiang ah,
Thupiak ka bawl hi, huchi a Israel a mite lak a amaute tengteng, ka gamsung a, asiampute uh leh Levi mite, amau ut thu petmah a Jerusalem a pai ding a theihsakte, nang kiang ah pai uhen.
"Kumpipa leh athudot mi sagihte'n, na khut a om na Pathian Dan dungzui a, Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu kan ding a, nang ahon sawl bang un;
atenna Jerusalem a om, Israel' Pathian kiang a man nei lou a kumpipa leh athudot mite'n apiaksate uh dangka leh dangka-eng po ding in,
Babulon bial tengteng a dangka leh dangka-eng na muh tengteng, mite leh siampute'n amau ut thu a thillat, Jerusalem a om a Pathian uh inn a dia uttak a alat tengteng uh toh.

"Huaiziak in thanopna toh hiai sum in bawngtalte, belamtalte, belamnoute na lei ding a, a-anpiak thillatte uleh adawn ding thillatte uh toh, huchi in Jerusalem a om na Pathian uh inn maitam tung ah huaite na lan ding hi.
Dangka leh dangka-eng om lai hihdan ding nang leh na unaute'n hoih na sak dandan uh, na Pathian uh deihlam bang in hih un.
Na Pathian inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuan ka hon piak uh, Jerusalem Pathian ma ah pia in.
Na Pathian inn ding a kiphamoh dangdangte, piakna ding na neih dingte, kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a kipan in pekhia in.

"Kei, kumpipa kei Artaksarses mahmah in luipi khen a om sumkem mite tengteng kiang ah thupiak ka bawl hi, huchi a Ezra siampu, van Pathian Dan, laigelhmi in nou ahon nget, thanuamtak a hih zel ahihtheihna ding in.
Dangka talent zakhat, huit buh tehna zakhat, uain bath zakhat, sathau bath zakhat leh aphazah gen lou in chi nangawn.
Bangpeuh van Pathian in thu apiak, van Pathian inn a ding in hih in om zel hen; aziak bel bang ding in kumpipa leh atapate gamsiatna ding in thangpaihna a-om dia?

Huai lou in leng ka hon chitaktak uh hi, siampute leh Levite, lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite, Nethinim mite hiam hiai Pathian inn sikhate lak a akuakua tungtang ah, van leimante, sumsinna leimante hiam lamlian leimante amau liausak dan ahi kei ding hi.
Huan nang, Ezra, na khut a om na Pathian pilna zui in, thukhenmi leh vaihawmmi, tuipi khen a omte mite tengteng vaihawm ding in sep in; na Pathian dante tengteng, huaite theiloute nou sinsak un.
Kuapeuh na Pathian dan leh kumpipa dan zui lou, sihna chiang hizong leh thanuamtak in atung ah vaihawmna bawl in om hen, ahihkeileh, khakmangna hiam, vankhakna hiam, suangkul lutna tan in," chi in.
Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn kilawmsak ding a, kumpipa lungtang a hichibang a thil koih, i pipute Pathian, TOUPA nuamsa in om hen;
heading: Ezra In Pathian Aphat

paite: Kumpipa leh athudot mite leh kumpipa vaihawmpih thilhihthei tengteng ma a ka tung a zahngaihna hon pepa amah ahi. Huchi in ka tung a TOUPA ka Pathian khut dungzui in hihhat in ka omta a, ka kiang a hoh ding in Israel a kipan mikizen tungtuan ka kaikhawmta hi.
